question: The acronym SONAR stands for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sound Navigation and Ranging.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Sonar**,** ****technique for detecting and determining the distance and direction of underwater objects by acoustic means. **
 
• **Sound waves emitted by or reflected from the object are detected by sonar apparatus and analyzed for the information they contain.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**Uses of sonar:-

 
• In the **military field are a large number of systems that detect, identify, and locate submarines.**
 
• **Sonar is also used in acoustic homing torpedoes, in acoustic mines, and in mine detection**.
 
• **Nonmilitary uses of sonar include fish finding, depth sounding, mapping of the sea bottom, Doppler navigation, and acoustic locating for divers.**
